name: Super Snapper FX
summary: The Super Snapper FX is Curgle's camera, lent to you for Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village. Daryn wants a picture of Gammerita, a creature from the Hinterlands.

sections.title: A New Invention
sections.body: Daryn Lightwind sends you to Curgle for her new invention, the Super Snapper FX. She asks for a snapshot of Gammerita, the creature from the Hinterlands, and expects you to bring the picture back to Rut'theran Village. Curgle says to aim at your subject and press the button.

faq.q: What is the Super Snapper FX?
faq.answer: The Super Snapper FX is a camera made by Curgle. Curgle lends it to you to take a picture of Gammerita for Daryn Lightwind.

faq.q: Who wants a picture of Gammerita?
faq.answer: Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village asks you to bring back a snapshot of Gammerita from the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Who made the Super Snapper FX?
faq.answer: Curgle built the Super Snapper FX for Daryn Lightwind.

faq.q: What does the Super Snapper FX do?
faq.answer: Aim the Super Snapper FX at what you want to photograph and press its button.
